observations.why: The declarative calibration pronouncement enacts authority — the speaker ratifies a state of the instrument as settled fact, performing institutional standing to declare readiness.
The labeled-field framing enacts a hierarchical organizing voice — the speaker structures the record as an authority would, classifying and certifying the instrument by category.
Citing verification against reference plates invokes a ranked chain of standards — the calibration's authority rests on deference to a prior, higher-order reference, enacting authority-ranking.
